title: Go security
intro: The practices of my GoLab talk, packaged so your agent can apply them to your repo: security CI, an audit that reports findings with evidence, and fuzz tests that prove a logic bug before anyone fixes it. Every file a skill writes is tested in CI against a real Go module first.

title: How I work
intro: The skills I run my writing and my speaking with. They are wired to my own setup (my notes, my queue, my voice), so they will not work for you as they are: read them, take what fits, change the rest.
